notes: Only assigned unfinished original fields examined. Other fields are unassigned null placeholders. PDF pp. 16–17 inspected for layout, metric symbols and signs; evidence quotes retain canonical text. Combining earned and unspecified conditions identifies a recoding, but the description does not identify the tested term. The paper reports the resource-by-fairness interaction for that recoding (F(1,247)=6.47, eta-squared .025), and a salient-fairness simple contrast (t(247)=2.81, PDF d=-0.51). A collapsed resource main-effect estimate is not printed. No term selected from the recoding alone.
